task.title: How to Input Scores
task.shortdesc: Inputting scores is one of the most important parts of scoring a Science Olympiad event, so here's how you do it!

context.p: Once you have graded all of the tests, it's time to start entering in scores!

step.cmd: In the "Raw Score" column, type in each team's scores

substep.cmd: Once you have done this, you can select where it says "By Number" to sort teams "By Score"

step.cmd: Check if you have any ties. It will say "TIE" in the "Notes" column in the team's row if that team is tied with anyone. A screenshot of the Anatomy and Physiology scoring tab, where both School A and School B have a raw score of 33 points. The notes column has "TIE" written in the row of both schools, and there is a red box drawing attention to this column.
If there are ties, follow the steps below. If there are none, move on to the next step.

substep.cmd: Refer to the designated tiebreaker questions to break the tie. If no tiebreaker questions have been designated, choose one.
In the "Tiebreak" column of the team that wins the tiebreaker, type 0.002
In the "Tiebreak" column of the team that loses the tiebreaker, type 0.001
In the event of a three-or-more-way tie, the first winner gets 0.003, the second winner gets 0.002, etc.
Repeat for any and all ties

step.cmd: Ensure all scores have been entered and any and all ties have been broken
